notes: Open/removed/extended states are treated as on; closed/inserted states are treated as off. The two pairs of upper-cabinet doors are reported separately because each door is a distinct movable part, although their individual transition order is only partly resolved by the 8-frame sampling.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen and then performs consecutive open-and-close interactions with the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, followed by lids on two countertop cookers and the drawer of an air fryer.
